The Soil *Soils are formed as a result of disintegration and decomposition of loosened up and unorganized rock materials, fossils of ﬂ ora and fauna, water and gas. Bedrock, climatic and biotic factors play a vital role in the formation of soil. The color, formation and minerals of the soil depend upon the bed rock. *Earthworms contribute to the formation of the soil and also increase its productivity. Hence, they are known as engineers of the ecosystem. Earthworms create pores in the soil, allowing the percolation of air and water and release of Carbon dioxide. *The faces of earthworm are helpful in increasing the productivity of the soil. Earthworms soften the soil up. They act as decomposers for the soil. *The excreted Urea and dead matter of the living organisms (ﬂ ora and fauna) is decomposed by decomposers in the soil. *This maintains the Nitrogen cycle and keeps providing Nitrogen to the soil. * Soil proﬁ le is a vertical section of soil in which all the soil horizons are shown. They are as follows: (1) Eluviations – The matter of upper stratum descend downwards. (2) Illuviation – Diﬀ erent salts are introduced from one horizon to another due to percolation of water. (3) Capillary Action – It is responsible for moving water from wet areas to dry areas of the soil. The smaller is the pore the higher is the capillary action and vice versa. *The capillary function is highest in the clay soil and minimum in sandy soils. The eﬀ ectiveness of capillary action in four diﬀ erent soils is as follows – Clay > Loam > Sandy soil > Sand. Podzol is a light colour soil of wood regions, mostly found in a cold temperate climate. * Chernozem soil is found in grassland and transitional areas. They are mostly found in a temperate steppe climate. They are also found in humid grasslands. * Laterite soil is found warm moist areas. The top layer of this soil has oxides of iron and salts of aluminium present. * Chestnut soil is found in dry areas. It is dark brown in colour and has low humus content as compares to Chernozen soil. *Sierozem soil is found in deserts of mid-latitudes. *Terra Rossa soil is a reddish silty soil, formed as a result of weathering of limestones. *Praire soil is found in the grassland areas of temperate regions. The soil is a mixture of Chernozem soil and greyish Podzol soil. *Soil conservation is not only about protecting the soil from eroding but also about taking measures to conserve soil fertility. To be precise sustainable use of soil is known soil conservation. *Soil erosion is a process through which top layer of soil along with nutrients is eroded from one place to another. *Contour Bunding is a method used to conserve soil in hilly areas. During rainfall, it prevents the soil from washing away. Under Contour Banding terrace like structures are made on Join−> https://t.me/thehindu000 CB–184 General Studies World Geography the slopes of the hilly areas which prevents the soil from washing away with the down ﬂ ush of water. *Since the tropical forests receive rain throughout the year the soils of the region are suﬀ ering from leaching. *Halophytes are vegetations that grow well in Alkaline Soil. *Vegetations growing well in cold regions are called Cryophytes. *Vegetation growing well in rock terrain are called Lithophytes, vegetations growing well in tropical deserts are called Xerophytes and vegetations growing well in swamps and marshes are called hydrophytes. 1. The Major Tribes of the World *Tribal people are those groups of people who are similar to each other on the basis of social customs, language and culture. *Nomadic Tribes are those group of people that travel from one place to another to ﬁ nd fodder for their cattle. Though Nomadic Tribes are found all over the world, they are mostly concentrated in arid regions. They are mostly found in the arid regions of Africa, Central Asia, and South America. *When people shift from one location to another in a particular season and then return to the same location after that particular season is over, then it is called seasonal migration for example when it starts to snow in the mountains the tribal people shift to the valley and return after the winter season is over. *Gaddi, Bakarwal, Bhotia are some of the tribes of India practice seasonal migration. *Pygmy Tribe is found in the rain forests of Congo Basin in Equatorial Africa. They are hunters and gatherers. They construct huts at the top of trees which are called Mongulu. They are black short- statured people of Negrito race. *Eskimo tribes are found in the tundra regions of Alaska, Canada and Greenland. They are of Mongoloid race and hunting is their main occupation. They use a weapon called the Harpoon and Kayak boat to catch ﬁ shes. *Inuit is a cultural group of indigenous people found in Join−> https://t.me/thehindu000 CB–186 General Studies World Geography arctic regions of Canada, Denmark (Greenland), Russia and Alaska. * Massai tribes are found plateau regions of East Africa which includes Kenya, North Tanzania and East Uganda. They are cattle herders and their main occupation is cattle rearing. They live in huts which are called Crawls. *Bushman Tribe is found in desert regions of Kalahari which includes South Africa, Zimbabwe, Swaziland, Botswana, Namibia, etc Hunting and Gathering is their main occupation. They are omnivorous. Termites are called the rice of Bushman. *Zulu Tribes reside in South Africa. They are known for their culture and rituals. The battle of Isandlwana was fought between the Britishers and Zulu tribe in 1879. The tribe practices agriculture and cattle rearing. *Semang tribe resides on the island of Malay in Malaysia. They belong to Negrito Race. They depend upon hunting and gathering. *Sakai tribe is found in the forests of the Malay Peninsula and Malaysia. They use blowpipe for hunting. * Papua tribes reside in Papuan New Guinea (Paciﬁ c Ocean). They practise agriculture and cattle rearing. *The Sami Tribe (Lapps Tribe) are found in Norway, Sweden, Finland and the Kola Peninsula in Russia. The region is also known as Scandinavia. *Bedouin tribes are found in the desert regions of Arals, especially in the Northern Part of Saudi Arab. Living in tribal groups they practise a migrant life. They belong to Negrito race. *The Bora Tribe is found in the coastal areas of Western Amazon Basin, Brazil, Peru and Colombia. They practice primitive agriculture and they are cruel in nature. *Kirghiz Tribe is tribes of Central Asia they are spread between Pamir Plateau in Kyrgyzstan to Tianshan mountain range. Kirghiz tribes are cattle rearing tribes who practice seasonal migration. They build round shaped temporary tents which are known as Yurt. *Yupik Tribe is found in Eastern Russia and Western Alaska. The tribe uses sledge (an ice cart driven by dogs). *Yukaghir is a Mongoloid tribe found in Verkhoyansk (North-East Siberia) and Stanovoy mountains. *Maya Tribe is found in Middle America. They are found in Mexico, Guatemala and Honduras. *Maori is a Polynesian tribe residing in New Zealand. Their main occupation is agriculture and gathering. *Among the other tribes of the world – Fulani Tribes reside in West Africa, Bantu Tribe resides in eastern, southern and central Africa, Nuba Tribe resides in Sudan, Vedda Tribe is found in Sri Lanka, Barber Tribe resides in Morocco, Enu Tribe resides in Japan and Aeta Tribe is found in the Philippines. *Important tribes of India are – Oran, Gond, Kol, Santhal, Bheel and Toda. *India is believed to be the indigenous place of the Gypsy. The Gypsy people are believed to be associated with Dome Caste (Schedule Caste) of India. *Archaeopteryx was the ﬁ rst bird to emerged on the Earth somewhere around 150 million years ago. *Africa is believed to be the birthplace of Mankind. At present, Caucasian Race is counted in one of the largest race on Earth. They have straight or curly hairs, dark blue or brown eyes with a Cranial Index of 80% and above. Hobble and Elliot Smith has categorized Caucasians in three groups – Nordic, Alpine and Mediterranean. *Caucasians are the largest group in the world. * Mongoloid race is mostly found in Central and Eastern Asia. They have yellowish and brown skin and have a small forehead. *Negroids are dark brown to brown in appearance.
